blocks.text: 作者以手机进行长期摄影创作，关注时间、光影与情绪在影像中的关系。
相比捕捉瞬间，更在意影像如何承载一段正在流动的时间，以及观看本身所带来的感受变化。
《慢下来，看见世界》并非摄影教程，而是一组关于节奏、观看与日常经验的摄影随笔。
这些影像与文字，来自行走途中，也来自平凡生活之中。

About the Author The author works primarily with mobile photography, focusing on the relationship between time, light, and emotional perception.Rather than capturing decisive moments, the author is more interested in how an image can carry the trace of time as it slowly unfolds.Slow Down, and See the World is not a photography manual,but a collection of reflective notes on seeing, rhythm, and everyday experience.The images and words in this book come from moments of travel as well as from ordinary daily life.
